title: Thai Pad See Ew
description: A classic Thai stir-fry dish made with flat rice noodles, vegetables, and a savory sauce.
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork or tofu and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and bean sprouts and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the pad thai sauce and see ew sauce and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with chopped peanuts.
